name: Sodomites
overview: The Scriptures depict the men of Sodom as engaging in grievous wickedness, specifically attempting to commit acts of sodomy, as seen when they pressed upon Lot to bring out his guests for immoral purposes (Genesis 19:4-9). This behavior provoked divine judgment, resulting in the city's destruction by fire. The term "sodomite" serves as a proverbial reproach for those practicing such acts, and the related Hebrew term translated as "harlot" applies even to males, underscoring the severity of this sin and its consequences.
